verdict.rationale: Postman offers a Postman API for programmatic asset management and a CLI that can run in CI/CD pipelines (docs-5, docs-6, docs-19, probe-6), which supports some APIOps-style automation, but there is no evidence of declarative, git-synced configuration of actual API gateway/traffic infrastructure—Postman's docs focus on collections, mocks, and tests rather than gateway routing/policy-as-code.
